text:
Sam C: @Ravi thanks for the intake — can you paste the dataset size and PHI fraction?
Ravi (TideHarbor): uploading now. we're seeing ~120k docs, ~8% PHI, mostly SSNs and clinical notes. need private deployment + HSM. renewal flagged as at-risk if latency stays >500ms.
Leila S: we usually recommend Dedicated + HSM for PHI. can we scope a smaller canary subset (2k docs) for safety + hallucination evals?
Ravi (TideHarbor): yes, 2k canary fine. also we need selective redaction and a 'no-diagnosis-inference' rule. sample prompts coming.
Sam C: noted. can you confirm the accept/reject rules for redaction so we can encode them in the eval harness?
Ravi (TideHarbor): policy summary: redact PII (SSNs, MRNs), keep encounter metadata (dates, meds). never infer a diagnosis or prognosis. examples: keep "patient reports chest pain"; redact "patient likely had MI".
Olga (CS Manager): flagging renewal risk — TideHarbor is a high-value account and they've been seeing uneven perf. recommend a targeted enablement + success playbook this quarter.
Leila S: proposed timeline:
- Week 1: safety checklist + canary evals on 2k docs (privacy-preserving sampling)
- Week 2: canary deployment in Private (us-west-2) + perf soak (48h)
- Week 3: enablement workshop + rollout plan + SLA review
Sam C: we'll need eng tickets for: model variant (7b-quant-sparse-adapter), reranker ground-truth integration, and canary infra. @deploy-bot can you create the triage tickets?
deploy-bot: created ENG-4127 (canary infra), ML-2189 (safety eval harness), SEC-77 (HSM integration). canary env provisioned in us-west-2, access invites sent to Ravi.
Sam C: quick snapshot from a short pilot we ran internally (small sample):
```
ROUGE-L: 0.67
Hallucination rate: 4.2% (target <2%)
Latency p95: 520ms (target <450ms)
Token cost vs baseline: 1.8x cheaper
```
Leila S: hallucination is above target — recommend adding a lightweight reranker + KB grounding (vector store against customer KB) and tightening generation temperature and max_new_tokens for safety.
Ravi (TideHarbor): ok to add reranker and grounding. safety > latency for us, but please try to hit p95 <500ms if possible.
Sam C: action items captured: Sam to run the 2k safety eval by Thu and post results; Leila to prepare KB grounding config and reranker tuning; Olga to schedule an enablement deck + renewal outreach; Ravi to share the formal redaction policy doc.
Ravi (TideHarbor): will share redaction doc and a 2k canary bundle by EOD tomorrow. thanks everyone.
Sam C: perfect — I'll update the thread when the eval artifacts are uploaded. :thumbsup:
